title: rope-handshake-vpipe-attn-kernel-and-continuous-batching
author: Aria Patel
description: Motivation: reduce repeated rotary/rope rematerialization and scheduling stalls when continuous batching crosses KV-cache boundaries. This PR introduces a lightweight "rope handshake" protocol between the attention microkernel and the KV cache manager plus a virtual-pipeline (vPipe) continuous batching runtime that keeps micro-batches in flight across CUDA streams. The change consolidates the rotary application and QK pre-softmax path into a single fused kernel that performs rotary embedding application, QK dot product, and scaled-softmax in-stream to reduce DRAM traffic and intermediate allocations. Goals: 1) reduce per-token memory bandwidth and kernel launch overhead for long-context workloads, 2) remove extra rotary recompute when a hot KV segment is spilled/reshuffled, 3) keep GPUs saturated with small interactive micro-batches using vPipe. What changed (high level): implemented a rope handshake ABI that attaches a small metadata header to KV segments (rope-base, rope-offset, handshake-version); modified kernel launcher to propagate handshake metadata; added fused-kernel attn_rope_handshake.cu implementing rotary+qk+softmax path with stream-aware loop unrolling; runtime changes in continuous_batcher to maintain vPipe slots and coordinate cross-stream fence points; KV manager updated to honor handshake hints and avoid rematerializing rotary embeddings when possible. Backwards compatibility: handshake metadata is optional — old kernels and KV stores ignore unknown headers; runtime falls back to legacy path when handshake version mismatch is detected. Checklist: [x] design doc and perf plan attached, [x] microbenchmark harness added, [x] integration tests for handshake ABI, [x] manual validation against existing perf canary, [x] doc updates to kernel interface. Performance: end-to-end throughput gains versus current mainline flash-attn baseline: +18% throughput for seq_len=8192 with batch-size=1 real-time inference profile; +11% for seq_len=4096; 95th-percentile tail latency reduced 7% for interactive sampling workloads. Microbench single-GPU kernel-level comparisons: fused rope-handshake kernel shows 1.12x effective tokens/sec compared to flash-attn-v4 for fp16 experiments on A100-40GB. Cost tradeoffs: slightly higher register pressure on some GPU SMs (resolved with a small vectorization fallback path), small increase in binary size due to handshake metadata helpers. Testing: unit tests for ABI, CUDA unit tests for fused kernel numerics (fp16/fp32) with randomized rotary offsets, integration perf runs in benchmark-lab, canary on perf-canary repository for 48h. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on mainline, enable vPipe on dedicated pools for 2 weeks monitoring through Redwood Console, gradual traffic ramp with automatic fallback to legacy kernel on increased error rate. Commits summary: "add rope handshake ABI and metadata helpers", "implement fused attn_rope_handshake kernel", "runtime: vpipe continuous batcher and slot allocator", "kv: handshake-aware segment manager and heuristics", "tests and perf harness updates". CI summary: initial CI failed on flaky trace test (GPU timing); fixed with fence ordering change and re-run; final CI status green. Merge: squash merge after two approvals and post-merge routine canary deployment. Related work: follows on ideas in ENG-2476 and complements previous async-prefetch and pipeline batching PRs; references design notes in docs/attn/rope-handshake.md. Release notes: Introduces an optional 'rope handshake' attention kernel and vPipe continuous batching for improved throughput on long-context workloads. Metrics and observability: emits new metrics continuous_batcher.inflight_slots, kv.handshake_misses, kernel.rope_handshake_latency for Console dashboards and alerting. Known limitations: handshake overhead can be slightly negative for tiny sequences (seq_len<=64) so the runtime disables vPipe by default for those cases. Deployment: feature gated under runtime.experimental.vpipe and kernel.experimental.rope_handshake. Merge method: squash and merge.
review_comments: Devon Nguyen (2025-11-24): Nice design. Two concerns: 1) register pressure on smaller SM GPUs could regress per-SM throughput; please add a vectorized fallback path. 2) Ensure handshake metadata doesn't inflate network copy size for multi-host KV replication.

Aria Patel (2025-11-25): Added vectorized fallback path and compacted handshake header to 16 bytes. KV replication now strips handshake hints across the wire and reattaches at host boundary; added tests.
Samir Rao (2025-11-27): Verified numerics against flash-attn across fp16/fp32 random seeds. Minor nits in logging format. Approving pending CI green.
Lina Chen (2025-12-01): Manual canary results look good; +15-20% throughput on long tail. Approved.
release_notes: Optional rope-handshake attention kernel and vPipe continuous batching added behind experimental flags. Improves throughput on long-context workloads; enabled via runtime.experimental.vpipe and kernel.experimental.rope_handshake.
